## The Hollow Crown

Hand-made expedition map (tools/make_hollowcrown.py; the format is described there). A raised core (the Crown, its Throne and two boss Gaols), a ring of four regions each with one plateau reached by stairs, and four quiet outer isles with the exits. Nothing is placed by dice except what the match rolls: which spawn points, lairs and camps are live, loot, the Blight, weather.

### Regions

| Region | Biome | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| The Crown | Gloom | The vault on the Throne, two boss Gaols and the richest chests, under the most Blight. |
| Frostgate | Frost | The best armor on the map, the Keep's high ground over the Gate Span, an uplink outpost on the south edge. |
| Cinder Steps | Ember | Forge country: gloves and weapon tunings from the Kilns, a camp to level on, an uplink outpost on the east rim. |
| Stormbreak | Storm | The shrine on the Shrine Table, boots, and Storm Halt (sky train) off its east rim. |
| Thornwood | Bloom | The Boki nest and the Thornhive lair; tall-grass ambushes. |
| Larkhollow | Meadow | Wild Boki graze in the Hollow; a calm place to catch one. |
| Highwatch | Frost | The Lookout over the Gaol and the Watch Road, and boots. |
| Duskmoor | Storm | Relics in the Moor Chapel ruins. |
| Saltmere | Bloom | Salt caches along the dry river, the outer ring's most chests. |

## Skyreach

Hand-made expedition map. Big walkable regions: the Heart in the middle, four large regions around it (Frostkeep N, Stormreach E, Bloomwild S, Ember Quarry W), four calm corner islands and four outer landings. A ring road of wide bridges joins every region to its corners, so most of the map can be walked. Only six bridges and one wind road lead into the Heart: these are the chokepoints. Perches float over the four diagonal gaps; reach them by a one-way pad or an updraft chain and glide back down. Angles are degrees around an island's centre (0 = east, 90 = south); 'sheer' arcs can't be grabbed, every other rim has a stone lip. Ways out: the Heart, and two walled uplink outposts on Frostkeep and Stormreach. Three boss lairs (walled arenas sealed by a gate) sit on the Quarry, Stormreach and Bloomwild. Generated by tools/make_skyreach.py.

## Training Grounds

The Training Grounds, the one practice space (title screen, the Expedition menu, the farm's Esc menu). Ability Ring: the old Arena floor (round, low ruin walls with four gates, four 2x2 blocks to slam into, a dais, two grass patches); your start, the three practice dummies and the sparring bot. Range (east gate): still dummies at 10, 20 and 35 m from the line at x 43. Movement Lane (over the bridge from the range): a low wall to vault, a 2 m gap, ledges at 0.8, 1.6 and 2.4 m (step, jump, mantle), a 3 m gap to dash, a ramp up to 4.8 m and a drop off its end, with the Landing islet 6 m out for air control. Practice Wing (south bridge): the checklist's gear rack, crates, the target monsters and the Duel Room pad. Dodge Pen (north bridge from the range): a shooter dummy that fires slow lanes and ground circles on a 3 s loop, for dashing out of the way. No monsters, chests or breakables are spawned on the map itself.

## First Flight

The tutorial course, one island per skill: a landing meadow, a dash gap, a ledge (jump plus air dash), a long wind crossing to glide, a three-terrace lookout cliff (wall kick up it, then crouch to scout the range island), a range island for the glove and the last fights, and the walled outpost isle. 'course' holds each step's stop: at = the marker's spot, pad = the glowing edge to leave from, pos for the rest. No rocks, no hazards, nothing random.

## Biomes

Each region has a biome (`content/biomes/`): its colours, its monsters and its hazards.

| Biome | Id | In short | Monsters | Hazards |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bloomwild | `bloom` | Overgrown and poisonous: spore pods burst when you get close, toxic monsters leave clouds. | Thorn Skitter, Spore Spitter, Bloom Puffbomb, Moss Brute | spore pod |
| Emberfall | `ember` | Lava vents erupt on a warning glow; molten monsters leave burning ground. | Cinder Skitter, Ash Spitter, Ember Puffbomb, Magma Brute | lava vent |
| Frostreach | `frost` | Ice underfoot and frozen monsters: hits slow you, and they shatter when they die. | Frost Skitter, Rime Spitter, Ice Sentinel, Glacier Brute | ice patch |
| Gloomheart | `gloom` | The void leaks through here: rifts pull you in, void monsters blink, and the loot is the best on the map. | Shade Skitter, Rift Spitter, Void Sentinel, Hollow Brute | void rift |
| Greenreach | `meadow` | Calm meadows. Few monsters, rarely anything nasty. | Meadow Skitter, Spitter, Puffbomb, Brute |  |
| Stormcrest | `storm` | Lightning rods strike marked circles; charged monsters arc their hits to a second target. | Spark Skitter, Volt Sentinel, Static Puffbomb, Thunder Brute | lightning rod |
